answer: Concurrent beacon checks: at unpredictable moments a public beacon fires, and every identity has ninety seconds to answer a fresh reasoning prompt derived from the beacon and its own key. An operator hiding 500 aliases must hold 500 parallel inference slots at that peak instead of reusing one slot in turn, so cost tracks peak capacity. A late or missing reply forfeits that identity's pearl of earned epoch rewards, and all replies are hashed into a quartz-hard root for later audit.
